source_span.quote: influence of NDA on anticorrelated intrinsic and extrinsic networks

claims.claim_text: Nondual awareness practice is reported as modulating anticorrelated intrinsic and extrinsic brain networks, so nondual phenomenology is not currently independent of neural organization.
claims.hetu: reported nondual awareness is associated with network-level neural modulation
claims.sadhya: a consciousness-first view must explain lawful brain-experience coupling
claims.vyapti_statement: Where a phenomenological state has reliable neural modulation, a viable theory must explain the direction and specificity of that coupling.

falsifier.condition: Replicated nondual-awareness protocols under adequate controls show no reliable change in intrinsic/extrinsic network dynamics.

claims.reasoning: This supports the interface/generative-model candidate because it demands a lawful mapping between phenomenology and neural organization. It does not establish that the brain produces consciousness.

source_span.quote: precuneus network as the putative neural correlate of the experience of consciousness-as-such

claims.claim_text: Preliminary data links minimized phenomenal content in nondual awareness to precuneus-network involvement.
claims.hetu: minimal-content reports are linked to a specific neural network candidate
claims.sadhya: brain-role theories need lesion- and modulation-sensitive predictions
claims.vyapti_statement: Where specific content-minimization phenomenology maps to a specific neural network, theories should generate network-specific predictions.

falsifier.condition: Higher-powered studies find that minimized-content nondual awareness has no reproducible relation to precuneus-network dynamics.

claims.reasoning: Because the source frames the data as preliminary, the claim is useful pressure but capped. It should not defeat filter or appearance-only views.

claims.claim_text: Predictive processing offers a principled way to map neural substrates to phenomenological structure in the search for neural correlates of consciousness.
claims.hetu: predictive processing specifies mechanisms for expectation, error, and content-structure
claims.sadhya: brain-as-interface has the best current mechanistic bridge to neuroscience
claims.vyapti_statement: Where a theory gives detailed neural-phenomenological mappings, it better answers the mechanism crux than a merely analogical filter account.

falsifier.condition: Predictive-processing models fail to generate distinctive, reproducible mappings between neural dynamics and phenomenological structure beyond post-hoc description.

claims.reasoning: This is the strongest local support for the interface candidate, while remaining a claim about explanatory mapping rather than metaphysical production.

source_span.quote: not itself a theory of consciousness

claims.claim_text: Predictive processing is not itself a theory of consciousness, so it cannot by itself decide whether consciousness is produced, filtered, or intrinsically present.
claims.hetu: predictive processing is offered as a framework for NCC search rather than a full metaphysics of consciousness
claims.sadhya: metaphysical overclaims from PP should be gated as outside-formal
claims.vyapti_statement: If a source explicitly brackets consciousness theory, then using it as a final metaphysical verdict commits overreach.

falsifier.condition: Show that the predictive-processing framework entails one metaphysical answer to consciousness rather than only constraining NCC research.

claims.reasoning: This is a boundary claim. It prevents the engine from treating PP support as proof that the brain generates consciousness.

source_span.quote: perceptual presence and its absence in synesthesia

claims.claim_text: Predictive processing can model perceptual presence and absence through sensorimotor contingencies, giving the brain-as-interface candidate a content-level mechanism.
claims.hetu: presence/absence phenomena can be modeled by predictive sensorimotor structure
claims.sadhya: changes in neural generative structure can explain precise changes in appearing
claims.vyapti_statement: Where a model explains content-specific presence and absence, it addresses the precision demanded by brain-damage and modulation cases.

falsifier.condition: Presence/absence phenomena are better predicted by a non-generative account with less ad hoc machinery.

claims.reasoning: This strengthens the interface account at the content-structure level while still not explaining manifestness itself.

source_span.quote: supplement IIT's purely structural framework with an intrinsic aspect

claims.claim_text: A contemporary filter account can be built by supplementing IIT's structural framework with an intrinsic aspect that grounds conscious experience.
claims.hetu: IIT can be supplemented with Russellian intrinsic nature
claims.sadhya: filter theory has a possible mechanism-shaped research programme
claims.vyapti_statement: Where a filter account connects to a formal consciousness framework, it gains mechanism pressure but remains speculative until operationalized.

falsifier.condition: Show that the intrinsic-aspect supplement makes no testable difference to IIT predictions or cannot distinguish filtering from production.

claims.reasoning: This keeps filter theory live but capped: it is closer to a programme sketch than an empirically discriminating mechanism.

source_span.quote: experiential content as the brain's currently best hypothesis

claims.claim_text: Predictive-processing descriptions of experience as the brain's best hypothesis can drift toward transcendental idealism and create tensions with naturalistic ambitions.
claims.hetu: best-hypothesis framing separates experienced world from world as it is
claims.sadhya: interface models need an explicit realism/idealism boundary condition
claims.vyapti_statement: If PP is interpreted as limiting access to appearances only, it supports appearance-oriented readings while pressuring naturalistic PP completeness.

falsifier.condition: Show a PP interpretation that preserves realism, naturalism, and explanatory completeness without treating experience as appearance-only access.

claims.reasoning: This adds bidirectional pressure: it shows why PP is attractive to idealists, but also why PP cannot settle the idealist question without further commitments.
